title: Correlations between quantitative parameters of contrast-enhanced ultrasound and vasculogenic mimicry in murine tumor model
author: Zhou, Cai, et al.

steps.title: Export CEUS DICOM files
steps.instruction: Download the CEUS video clips from the Philips iU22 xMATRIX ultrasound system and save them in DICOM format.

steps.title: Analyze CEUS images
steps.instruction: Open the DICOM files in SonoLiver (TomTec Imaging System, Germany). Draw a region of interest (ROI) around the tumor lesion and an ROI in adjacent reference tissue based on the conventional ultrasound image. Apply motion‑compensation to suppress respiration noise. Generate the time‑intensity curve (TIC) and fit it with the bolus‑kinetics model. Calculate four perfusion parameters: rise time (RT, time from 10 % to 90 % of IMAX), time to peak (TTP, time from contrast arrival to 100 % IMAX), maximal intensity (IMAX, percentage ratio of lesion ROI intensity to reference ROI intensity at peak), and mean transit time (mTT, time from 50 % IMAX on the ascending branch to 50 % IMAX on the descending branch).

steps.title: Fix and embed tumor tissue
steps.instruction: Fix harvested tumor tissues in 4 % formaldehyde, cut through the plane of maximum diameter, embed in paraffin, and cut 5 µm sections.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and rehydrate sections
steps.instruction: Place sections in xylene, then pass them through a decreasing ethanol gradient to rehydrate.

steps.title: Antigen retrieval
steps.instruction: Heat the sections in citric acid buffer (pH 6.0) for antigen retrieval.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with 3 % hydrogen peroxide to quench endogenous peroxidase activity.

steps.title: Block nonspecific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with 10 % bovine serum albumin (BSA, Boster, Wuhan, China) to block nonspecific sites.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections overnight at 4 °C with anti‑CD31 antibody (Sangon Biotech, Shanghai, China).

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with biotinylated goat anti‑rabbit IgG (Boster, Wuhan, China).

steps.title: Streptavidin‑biotin complex
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with Strept Avidin‑Biotin Complex (SABC, Boster, Wuhan, China).

steps.title: DAB chromogen development
steps.instruction: Develop immunohistochemical staining using DAB solution (Beyotime, Nantong, China).

steps.title: Periodic acid treatment
steps.instruction: Treat sections with 0.5 % periodic acid solution (Leagene, Beijing, China) and rinse with distilled water.

steps.title: Schiff reagent staining
steps.instruction: In a dark chamber, incubate sections with Schiff solution (Leagene, Beijing, China), then rinse with distilled water.

steps.title: Hematoxylin counterstain
steps.instruction: Counterstain sections with hematoxylin (Leagene, Beijing, China), then proceed to dehydration and coverslip mounting.

steps.title: Dehydrate and mount
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the stained sections through graded alcohols, clear, and mount with a coverslip.
